info.title: CoArena API
info.description: Every CoArena feature, over HTTP. Authenticate with a personal API key (Authorization: Bearer coa_…) minted on your account page; each operation names the scope it needs. Errors share one envelope, except on the Model API (/api/v1), which answers in OpenAI's or Anthropic's so their SDKs can parse it (x-coarena-envelope on each operation says which); 429 and 503 carry Retry-After. See /developers.

get.summary: The models the Model API offers, in one list that both OpenAI and Anthropic clients read. No key is needed.

default.description: 200 {object:'list', data:[{id, object:'model', created, owned_by, type:'model', display_name, created_at, lifecycle, max_input_tokens, max_tokens, context_length, max_completion_tokens, pricing, capabilities, aliases}], has_more:false, first_id, last_id}. Cache: public, max-age=5. With the Model API not enabled on the deployment, data is [] and x-coarena-model-api: off; with the operator's master switch off, data is [] and x-coarena-model-api: switched-off; a model switched off is left out.

get.description: Request: none; a key is not read

options.summary: CORS preflight for the Model API operations on this path.

default.description: 204, no body: Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, Allow-Methods 'GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS', Allow-Headers echoing the requested names (validated) else 'authorization, x-api-key, content-type, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta', Max-Age 600; never Allow-Credentials.

get.summary: The calling key's account: its free daily limit and today's use, its minute and at-once limits, its daily request limit when an operator set one, its ask for higher limits, whether it may ask now, and how. Either Model API scope will do.

default.description: 200 {data:{free:true, usd_per_day, default_usd_per_day, source (default|granted), granted_until, requests_per_minute_key, requests_per_minute_account, requests_per_minute_model, default_requests_per_minute, requests_per_day (null: no daily request limit, the default), concurrency, today:{used_usd, held_usd, left_usd, requests, requests_left (null with no daily request limit), resets_at, refused:{rate, concurrency, quota, shared}}, request:null|{id, status (pending|granted|declined|withdrawn), requested_usd (null when the ask names no dollars), granted_usd, requested:{usd_per_day, requests_per_minute, requests_per_day} (null when not named), granted:null|{usd_per_day, requests_per_minute, requests_per_day} (null requests_per_day: the cap removed), note (null when none), decision_note, source (dashboard|api), created_at, decided_at} (waiting, or decided in the last 14 days), can_ask, cannot_ask:null|limit_request_no_calls|limit_request_pending|limit_at_max (every limit that can be asked for at its max)|model_api_terms_required|account_withdrawn|account_blocked, next_steps_usd:[up to 3], next_steps_requests_per_minute:[up to 3], next_steps_requests_per_day:[up to 3; [] with no daily request limit], max_usd_per_day:100000, max_requests_per_minute:600, max_requests_per_day:100000, ask:null|{method:'POST', url, body:{usd_per_day (or at $100,000 requests_per_minute), note:'optional'}, example (a curl line), fields:{usd_per_day:{now, next}, requests_per_minute:{now, next}, requests_per_day?:{now, next} (only with a daily request limit)}}, page}} (no-store, private)

get.summary: The calling key's account's credits: plan ('free' until its first purchase), balance, held, available, auto-recharge, the discount below list price, and where to buy more. Either Model API scope will do.

default.description: 200 {object:'credits', plan:'free'|'paid'|'suspended', on_sale, balance_usd, held_usd, available_usd, discount_pct, free_daily_usd (null once paid), auto_recharge:{enabled, threshold_usd, amount_usd}, buy_url} (no-store, private)
